original_test_intent: Validate the server's required CPU, memory, PCIe and GPU RAS capabilities with the approved NVRAS suite and establish a genuine 100% result over the fixed test manifest, including correct error detection, logging, containment and recovery for any explicitly authorized stimuli.
original_method: Pin NVRASTool build, suite/configuration and expected-test manifest; bind CPU MCA/EDAC/memory, PCIe AER/DPC, GPU XID/row-remap/retirement and BMC event capabilities to the platform/firmware/kernel/driver matrix; classify every test as observational or fault-injecting with exact target, severity, mechanism, expected propagation and recovery; preserve baselines; run passive tests first and obtain separate authorization per active stimulus; retain raw host/BMC/device records and reconcile every result state to the approved 100% denominator without clearing or retrying.
manual_activity: Owner/NVIDIA RAS engineer supplies the capability and stimulus contract, approves each fault target and severity separately, and owns containment and recovery decisions.
required_inputs: NVRAS tool version/hash/license, exact suite command/configuration and expected-test manifest
Platform CPU/memory/PCIe/GPU/BMC RAS capabilities and compatible BIOS/BMC/GPU/retimer/SSD firmware, kernel, driver, rasdaemon and EDAC matrix
Per-test passive or injection classification with physical/logical target, error severity, expected OS/device/BMC propagation, timing and acceptance
Denominator/waiver policy, maintenance isolation, out-of-band recovery and data/service impact approval
safety_requirements: Run read-only capability/baseline steps before any stimulus and preserve existing error history
Never inject a fault, reset a device or clear RAS records without separate target-specific approval
Use a dedicated SUT and monitor containment, device availability, thermal/power and management reachability
Stop on unexpected escalation, wrong target, uncontained error, data-risk condition, hang/reboot or incomplete event chain
agent_execution_scope: Validate suite/tool, platform RAS map, expected manifest, event oracles and recovery
Collect passive baseline; execute only separately approved stimuli one at a time
Correlate injection or observation with complete device, kernel and BMC event chains and result artifacts
Do not infer stimulus safety, clear counters/logs, exclude non-pass results, retry injections or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVRAS suite and complete platform RAS capability/compatibility matrix
Approve every active stimulus target/severity/expected propagation/containment/recovery and 100% accounting
Review complete event-chain and per-test artifacts and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: rasdaemon, EDAC sysfs and kernel RAS messages are useful baseline sources, but the command does not run NVRAS, uses insecure/truncated collection and cannot prove injected-event propagation or 100% coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned NVRAS suite only after manifest and event-oracle review; keep passive and separately approved injection phases distinct, preserving complete pre/event/post RAS records and all result states.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Follow NVRAS procedures, 100% pass rate, no bundle, and 60/480-minute allocation remain; fault targets and denominator are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each capability, define a causal chain from approved observation or stimulus through hardware/firmware detection, OS/device logging, containment and recovery, then reconcile the complete chain to a fixed suite manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds subsystem-specific RAS scope, explicit injection boundaries, event correlation, containment, denominator rules and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: RAS inventory can exist while detection, severity mapping, containment or recovery fails; a vendor 100% summary can also hide skipped or unsupported capabilities.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault injection can crash the host, reset devices, corrupt workloads or escalate beyond the intended target; suite semantics and platform support are vendor-specific.

project_override_considerations: Project RAS tests can substitute only with NVIDIA/owner-approved mapping to every required NVRAS capability and event chain. Generic rasdaemon presence, EDAC directories or historical errors do not replace controlled qualification.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVRAS build/hash/license, exact suite/configuration and expected-test manifest
Complete platform firmware/kernel/driver/rasdaemon/EDAC and CPU/memory/PCIe/GPU/BMC capability matrix
For each test: passive/injection classification, approved target/severity, exact command/parameters, timestamps and complete hardware/firmware/OS/device/BMC event chain
Containment/recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require NVRAS server-capability qualification at 100%. Missing suite and stimulus behavior are specification gaps, not conflicting objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The RAS qualification target is clear. Vendor suite, capability map and stimulus definitions are supplyable prerequisites; no fault is authorized merely by completing this static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2155 Wistron-HGX NV PVP SW-00003-V002: approve the NVRAS version/hash/license, exact suite/configuration and expected-test manifest; CPU/memory/PCIe/GPU/BMC firmware/kernel/driver/rasdaemon/EDAC capability matrix; each test's passive versus injection target/severity/event propagation/containment/recovery; 100% denominator/waiver policy, separate stimulus approvals, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Separates harmless RAS inventory from potentially destructive fault injection and makes 100% depend on complete causal event-chain evidence rather than tool presence or truncated logs.
independent_technical_reasoning: RAS capability is not demonstrated by rasdaemon installation or existing EDAC files; it requires the intended error to be detected at the correct layer, assigned the correct severity, propagated to all required logs, contained and recovered. Because injections can escape their target, each needs a separately approved blast radius and first-fault stop. Complete preserved logs are essential: clearing or tailing can remove the only evidence linking stimulus to response.
